newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar closes flat at 476.75/477.75dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar closes flat at 476.75/477.75dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 476.75/477.75 bolivars per dollar in light dealing and with little offer from the Central Bank, brokers said.
"The market was pretty similar to yesterday but could do with the Central Bank selling a bit more dollars," one trader said.
Most brokers expect a similar pattern next week with little fluctuation in the exchange rate, or a tendency for the bolivar to rise if interest rates remain high.
